title: Size Points on Mobile Wallet Wrong-Wallet Re-Credits
content:
FX desk rate card: **Mobile Wallet** wrong-wallet re-credits earn size points according to the principal Paloma holds for the transfer when the re-credit is sent.

The principal Paloma holds is the transfer's funds-received, reversed-credit and Paloma-credit entries less its credit-sent and refund entries.

| Principal Paloma holds when the re-credit is sent (USD) | Size points |
|---|---|
| 500.00 or more | 0.20 |
| at least 100.00 and below 500.00 | 0.10 |
| below 100.00 | nothing |

## Hypothetical cases

| Funds received | Credits sent | Paloma credits | Principal held | Size points |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 600.00 | 600.00 | 600.00 | 600.00 | 0.20 |
| 450.00 | 450.00 | 450.00 | 450.00 | 0.10 |
| 450.00 | 450.00 | none | 0.00 | nothing |
| 80.00 | 80.00 | 80.00 | 80.00 | nothing |
